body.check_says: The check establishes that a citation points at a source. It does not judge whether the source supports the sentence.
body.numbering_say: Numbered as the report prints them: each source at its first citation, in reading order. Only the sources the printed text cites are listed, each once.

check.say: Every citation a model wrote points at a source that was supplied to it.

parts.say: Every citation in the gene-level interpretations points at a paper that was offered.
